Q1: C.I. Solvent Yellow 2 presents known GHS-recognized hazards for carcinogenicity, mutagenicity, reproductive effects, and oral toxicity. Expanded scientific data indicate additional environmental, inhalation, and dermal/eye hazards. However, organ and systemic hazards remain data deficient.
Q2: C.I. Solvent Yellow 2 appears on several prominent lists of concern, including California Proposition 65, as a Hazardous Air Pollutant, and is classified by IARC as "possibly carcinogenic to humans" (Group 2B), indicating significant health and environmental concerns.
Q3: With over 5,000 literature references and a well-defined molecular structure, C.I. Solvent Yellow 2 is extensively studied in the scientific literature. While it has a moderate number of toxicity records in the EPA ToxValDB, it lacks comprehensive IRIS or PPRTV assessments, and organ/systemic hazards are data deficient, suggesting some gaps in its complete toxicological characterization.
